how_to_apply: NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026 does not have an online application portal. Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format, sent only by Registered Post/Speed Post, so that it reaches the office on or before 17 October 2026, 5:00 PM.
Download/obtain the prescribed application format included with the notification.

Fill in personal details, educational and training qualifications (starting from the highest qualification down to at least 10th standard), and work experience (voluntary/unpaid work is not counted as experience).
Attach self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets. Candidates submitting CGPA scorecards must also attach the CGPA-to-percentage conversion chart.

Attach category certificate (if claiming reservation), residence certificate, matriculation certificate for date of birth, computer proficiency certificate (if applicable), and two self-attested passport-size photographs.
Attach the Demand Draft for the applicable application fee, made in favour of "District Rural Health Society, Simdega-RCH."
Enclose a declaration/affidavit that the candidate has not been convicted in any criminal case, along with a medical fitness certificate issued by a registered Civil Surgeon.
Clearly write the Advertisement Number, Post Code and Post Name on top of the envelope.

Send the sealed envelope by Registered Post/Speed Post only to the address below. Applications submitted to any other office will be automatically rejected, and those received after the deadline will not be considered.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form (with separate fee) for each post.

content_sections.heading: NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: National Health Mission (NHM), Simdega, Jharkhand has released the NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026 notification for the recruitment of Staff Nurse, District PPM Coordinator, ANM, Block Data Manager, ARSH Counselor, Sanitary Attendant and Rehabilitation Worker posts. A total of 18 vacancies across 8 post codes have been announced on a contract basis, with applications invited through offline mode up to 17 October 2026, 5:00 PM. Download NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: NHM Simdega Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification specifies the following date. The application start date and interview/exam dates are not mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NHM Simdega Vacancy 2026: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026 covers 8 posts with a total of 18 vacancies, including 3 regular vacant posts and 15 backlog vacancies. Reservation is applied district-wise as per the roster. Note: UR = Unreserved, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe, EWS = Economically Weaker Section. The notification states that in Simdega district, reservation for Extremely Backward Class (Schedule-I) and Backward Class (Schedule-II) posts is currently nil (शून्य); candidates from these categories may apply under EWS with a valid certificate from the Sub-Divisional Officer/Circle Officer level.

The final merit list will be prepared by the District Selection Committee, Simdega, and published on the office of the Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer and on the Simdega district website (https://www.simdega.nic.in). A waitlist will also be prepared and remains valid for one year. Selected candidates will be informed by registered post and through the district website.

faq.question: Q1. What is NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contract-based recruitment drive by the District Health Society, Simdega (under the National Health Mission, Jharkhand) to fill 18 vacant and backlog posts, including Staff Nurse, ANM, District PPM Coordinator, Block Data Manager, ARSH Counselor, Sanitary Attendant, and Rehabilitation Worker, under Advertisement No. 01/NHM/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 total vacancies across 8 posts - 3 regular vacant posts and 15 backlog vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application by Registered Post/Speed Post is 17 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post - ranging from 10th/12th pass with hospital experience (Sanitary Attendant) to GNM/ANM nursing qualifications and postgraduate degrees (PPM Coordinator, ARSH Counselor). See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age is calculated as on 31 August 2026. The maximum age limit ranges from 35 years (Unreserved/EWS) to 40 years (SC/ST), with additional relaxation for women, backward classes and persons with disabilities. See the age limit table above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 400/- for General/Backward Class/Extremely Backward Class/EWS candidates, and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST candidates, payable by Demand Draft in favour of "District Rural Health Society, Simdega-RCH."

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application process. Candidates must send the completed application form, along with self-attested documents and the DD, by Registered Post/Speed Post to the Civil Surgeon-cum-Chief Medical Officer, Simdega, at the address given in the "How to Apply" section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHM Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-point scheme covering 10th marks (10 points), 12th marks (10 points), essential qualification (40 points), relevant higher qualification (25 points), and an interview/written test (15 points).
